note: Version-locked groups of the optional scientific packages. Each pin is the version CI installed and tested in run 38112219558 (2026-10-11, Python 3.12.15, ubuntu-latest x86_64), except where 'verified_by' says otherwise. Readiness (bioagent validate deps) imports every package and runs a calculation whose answer is known; a version other than the pin is reported UNVERIFIED, a missing package BLOCKED. Nothing installs itself: a group is installed with its command, after a person reads it, or through Studio's env.provision job, which asks first.

docking.purpose: AutoDock Vina docking with meeko preparation (pipeline.dock, skill.dock-ligands)

admet.purpose: descriptors, rule filters, alerts and the trained endpoints (pipeline.admet)

openmm.note: in an environment of its own named by the reviewed environments file (docs/compute-tasks.md)

statistics.purpose: the numerical core and model fitting

transcriptomics.purpose: RNA-seq differential expression and single-cell analysis (pipeline.rnaseq, pipeline.scrna)

structure_prediction.verified_by: not installed by CI: the model weights are gigabytes and the run is by hand; transformers has no tested pin

data_files.purpose: the formula workbook and Parquet tables
